title: Synthesis of water-soluble novel bioactive pyridine-based azo coumarin derivative and competitive cytotoxicity, DNA binding, BSA binding study, and in silico analysis with coumarin.
authors: Karan, Putul; Shit, Basudev; Panja, Poulami; Khatun, Amina; Pal, Jagannath; Chakarabarti, Sudipta; Pal, Sutanuka; Ghosh, Avishek; Hossain, Maidul
one_liner_zh: 该文合成水溶性偶氮香豆素衍生物并研究其细胞毒性、DNA/BSA结合及分子对接，虽涉及小分子-DNA结合但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The diazo coupliling reaction of 3- amino pyridine with coumarin in water medium produces water soluble 6-[3-pyridyl]azocoumarin. The synthesised compound has been fully charecterised by IR, NMR, and Mass spectroscopy. The frontier molecular orbital calculations reveal that 6-[3-pyridyl]azocoumarin is more biologically and chemically active in comparison to coumarin. The cytotoxicity evaluation confirms that 6-[3-pyridyl]azocoumarin is more active than coumarin against human brain glioblastoma cell lines, LN-229 with IC(50) value 9.09 muM (IC(50) value for coumarin is 9.9 muM). The compound (I) has been synthesized by coupling of diazotized solution of 3-aminopyridine with coumarin in an aqueous medium at  approximately  pH 10. The structure of the compound (I) has been characterized using UV-vis, IR, NMR, and Mass spectral studies. Frontier molecular orbital calculations reveal that 6-[3-pyridyl]azocoumarin (I) is more active chemically and biologically in comparison to coumarin. IC(50) value 9.09 and 9.9 muM of 6-[3-pyridyl]azocoumarin and coumarin respectively obtained in cytotoxicity evaluation confirms the enhanced activity of the synthesized compound against human brain glioblastoma cell lines, LN-229. The synthesized compound also shows strong binding interactions with DNA and BSA in comparison with coumarin. The DNA binding study shows groove binding interaction of the synthesized compound with CT-DNA. The nature of interaction, binding parameters and structural variations of BSA in the presence of the synthesized compound and coumarin have been evaluated using several usefull spectroscopy approaches such as UV -Vis, time resolved and stady state flurescence. The molecular docking interaction has been carried out to justify the experimental binding interaction with DNA and BSA.
abstract_zh: 3-氨基吡啶与香豆素在水介质中的重氮偶联反应生成水溶性的6-[3-吡啶基]偶氮香豆素。合成化合物已通过IR、NMR和质谱法充分表征。前沿分子轨道计算表明，6-[3-吡啶基]偶氮香豆素在生物和化学活性方面均高于香豆素。细胞毒性评价证实，6-[3-吡啶基]偶氮香豆素对人脑胶质母细胞瘤细胞系LN-229的活性高于香豆素，其IC(50)值为9.09 μM（香豆素的IC(50)值为9.9 μM）。化合物(I)通过在约pH 10的水介质中将3-氨基吡啶的重氮化溶液与香豆素偶联而合成。化合物(I)的结构已通过UV-vis、IR、NMR和质谱研究表征。前沿分子轨道计算表明，6-[3-吡啶基]偶氮香豆素(I)在化学和生物活性方面均高于香豆素。细胞毒性评价中获得的6-[3-吡啶基]偶氮香豆素和香豆素的IC(50)值分别为9.09和9.9 μM，证实了合成化合物对人脑胶质母细胞瘤细胞系LN-229的增强活性。与香豆素相比，合成化合物还显示出与DNA和BSA的强结合相互作用。DNA结合研究表明，合成化合物与CT-DNA发生沟槽结合相互作用。在合成化合物和香豆素存在下，BSA的相互作用性质、结合参数和结构变化已通过多种有用的光谱方法评估，如UV-Vis、时间分辨和稳态荧光。分子对接相互作用已进行，以验证与DNA和BSA的实验结合相互作用。
